doc: Rules of the rehearsal plan (STANDARDS section 10.15, P-P). Every threshold and set is here, not in code. A limit that has no source is not in this file. Limits that come from a mission (landing and driving slope) are NOT copied here: each card carries its own limit and source in mission_pct.<kind>.limit_deg and mission_pct.<kind>.source, and the evaluator reads them from the card. Body facts are read from config/bodies.json. Light values are read from data/derived/light/light.json (P-S). Status vocabulary: yes | partial | no | null (null = input missing, with a reason).

landing.label: Landing: share of 100 m terrain under the landing slope limit, target vs twin
landing.rule: difference = |analog - target| in percentage points; yes if <= yes_max_points, partial if <= partial_max_points, else no

driving.label: Driving: share of 100 m terrain under the driving slope limit, target vs twin
driving.rule: difference = |analog - target| in percentage points; yes if <= yes_max_points, partial if <= partial_max_points, else no

cold.label: Cold: the twin's Koppen-Geiger class is a cold class (the target's temperature range is shown with it)
cold.rule: analog class in cold_koppen_classes -> partial (best possible: no Earth climate reaches the body's temperature range, see temperature); otherwise no
cold.class_source: Beck et al. 2018/2023 Koppen-Geiger 1 km map (card context.sources.koppen); class names from data/raw/reference/koppen/legend.txt
cold.source: STANDARDS.md section 10.15 (cold set and best status partial)

low_sun.label: Low sun: share of samples with the Sun in the grazing band (0 to 10 deg elevation), target vs twin
low_sun.rule: yes if analog >= target - yes_within_points; partial if analog >= target * partial_min_fraction_of_target; else no. For no: the lowest |latitude| on Earth whose grazing_pct reaches the target is named (scan |lat| 0..90 in earth_scan_step_deg steps with analog.core.light, Earth obliquity from config/light.json), or the line says that no latitude on Earth reaches it, with the Earth maximum and its latitude
low_sun.source: STANDARDS.md section 10.15 (P-S light: grazing_pct = 100 * share of samples with 0 < e < 10 deg)

gravity.label: Gravity: the twin's gravity is Earth's; the target's is lower or higher
gravity.source: config/bodies.json (source_url of the target body, NASA Planetary Fact Sheet)

pressure.label: Atmospheric pressure: the twin has Earth's surface pressure; the target's is a fraction of it
pressure.source: config/bodies.json (source_url of the target body, NASA Planetary Fact Sheet)

temperature.label: Temperature range: the twin's printed range does not reach the target's range
temperature.source: config/bodies.json (source_url of the target body and of earth, NASA Planetary Fact Sheet)

day_length.label: Day length: the twin's day is 24 h; the target's is different
day_length.source: config/bodies.json (source_url of the target body, NASA Planetary Fact Sheet)
